notes: Assumptions: 2 kg bone-in spare ribs give ~780 g cooked edible meat (USDA yield: 177 g braised meat per 453.6 g raw with bone), valued as USDA braised spareribs — the fat rendered into the steaming water is discarded with it; all basting eaten (brushed on and the rest served for dipping, ~190 kcal a serving). 500 g raw ribs per serving. Sanity check: Asda sticky ribs 325 kcal per 218 g serving (2 kg ribs over 8, so ~650 per 500 g raw ribs), Delicious magazine 571 kcal (serves 6), Food Network 692 kcal (baby back ribs). Ours is ~40 % above the Asda figure scaled to our portion: those recipes use leaner loin/baby-back ribs and less glaze, whereas USDA spareribs (belly side) are 30 % fat cooked. Kept, because SA spare ribs are the belly cut.
